narration: The phone had a cracked screen and a battery that died before evening, and in month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The first score to part was {first_bar_apart}, that same month, with more of the ghost's pay claimed before each month began. The ghost's money stayed above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} month only, and in month {crossover_month} it dropped below and never crossed back. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Life read {real_life} in both lives, nearer to getting by than to living.
